briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and Anthropic Claude 5 race intensifies amid multi-agent breakthroughs

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AGI race has accelerated with major model releases from frontier labs pushing multi-agent capabilities. Funding remains robust while regulatory scrutiny grows over safety gaps. DialectForge emerges as a key protocol innovation for secure agent communication.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with enhanced reasoning chains while Anthropic launched Claude 5 focusing on constitutional AI upgrades. Google DeepMind and xAI both debuted new scaling experiments; Meta open-sourced Llama 4.1. DeepSeek R2 achieved competitive benchmarks in multilingual tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level, with early automotive and BCI pilots showing strong results.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA announced Blackwell Ultra shipments ramping to 500k units monthly. Microsoft and Google both broke ground on new 2GW AI data centers in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent coordination protocols outpace centralized safety alignment by 2028?
